thread.title: Apple to launch streaming service this spring, per report

author: Annlee Ellingson
title: Apple to launch streaming service this spring, per report
text: – Staff Writer, L.A. Biz Jan 29, 2019, 12:35pm PST Apple Inc. is moving forward with plans to launch its video platform this year, with a new report pegging the timeline as early as this spring. The computer giant told content partners prepping movies and television shows for the service “to be ready for launch by mid-April,” reported The Information , citing three anonymous sources, though the actual launch could fall “within several weeks of that date.” The move would have Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) launching its streaming service around the same time Disney plans to demonstrate its own platform at its April 11 investor meeting, though Disney+ isn’t slated for release until later in 2019. WarnerMedia also plans to launch a streaming service this year, with NBCUniversal following suit in 2020. Still not much is known about Apple’s platform, including how much it will cost or even what form it will take. In October, it was reported that Apple plans to put the service on its iPhones, iPads and Apple TVs in the preinstalled “TV” app. Owners of such devices will be able to watch Apple’s original content for free , as well as sign up for subscription channels from other companies, a la Amazon Channels. Interestingly, this week’s tidbit about the timeline for Apple’s service came in a larger report about how Amazon is scaling back that initiative. Meanwhile, Roku started rolling out its own version, offering premium subscriptions to Showtime, Starz and Epix on The Roku Channel. When Apple does launch its service, it plans to to take it global in more than 100 countries, expanding internationally in the months following its U.S. launch. Apple has committed an initial $1 billion to content for that initiative, which has signed deals with “Parenthood” showrunner Jason Katims, Justin Lin (several “Fast & Furious” movies and “Star Trek: Beyond”), Oprah Winfrey, Sesame Workshop and Peanuts, and is working on series including “Amazing Stories,” a drama about a morning new show starring Jennifer Aniston, Reese Witherspoon and Steve Carell, and a thriller from M. Night Shyamalan, among other projects. Click here to read more.
